headline: The island that rules a key industry! Europe can't copy it: here's the secret
summary: Governments in the United States, Europe and Japan are investing billions in domestic chip production, while TSMC expands plants beyond Taiwan amid the US-China technology conflict.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chip manufacturer, and shifts in where advanced chips are made affect the supply chains of the entire technology sector.

impacts.name: TSMC
impacts.why: TSMC is expanding production beyond Taiwan as trade tensions split global chip supply chains.
